mutants.description: [LLM] FirstPairOnly: merges only the first adjacent equal pair
[LLM] SortAscendingMerge: sorts the non-zero tiles ascending, then merges adjacent equals once
[LLM] SortDescendingMerge: sorts the non-zero tiles descending, then merges adjacent equals once
[LLM] MergeByValue: merges all tiles of the same value into one tile (value * count)
[LLM] RepeatedMerge: keeps merging adjacent equal tiles until none remain
[LLM] MergeCompatible: merges adjacent tiles if equal or one is double the other (sum)
